headline: Approved $200 sponsorship of a Sound of Music movie night to raise money for a student trip to Europe.
summary: A public speaker estimated about 100 people would attend, and the $200 covers the movie licensing fee. Money raised goes to coach bus rides to and from Logan airport for a trip in April 2028.
decisions: Approved $200 to sponsor a Sound of Music movie night fundraiser for a student trip to Europe.
discussion: Poet laureate succession: The current poet laureate's two-year term ends February 1. A member suggested putting the role's requirements on a future agenda, and a public speaker said an application process exists.

Sound of Europe trip funding: A public speaker said 34 people had signed up for an April 2028 trip to Germany, Austria, Slovakia, and Hungary. Students still need money for coach rides to and from Logan airport, and a question was raised about who pays custodial costs.

Downtown Live ticket sales: Members-only sales topped $9,000 on one day. The update said the theater had about $12,000 in profit from fall shows through December 5, though it still carries a deficit from earlier shows.

Traffic box art: Public works plans to refurbish six or eight traffic boxes, and members asked for photos of painted boxes before they are replaced. A proposed artist for one box was dropped after a phone call.
Page Park Ski Lodge: A proposal to repaint and reorganize the lodge, where summer art camps are held, may come to the commission for funding.

decision_evidence.quote: So put an entertainer motion in that respect that we're providing a cultural and arts opportunity at an arts magnet school. I will make that motion. ... All those in favor of funding this initiative? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? No, okay. I'm going to ask for the anonymous consent. Theresa, we will fund your push for the viewing.

decision_titles: $200 sponsorship of Sound of Music movie night at BAME's
